extName.message: Reelster — export Reels from Instagram DMs

extDescription.message: Download every Reel sent and received in an Instagram DM conversation as a single .tar.gz.

popupHint.message: Open a conversation at instagram.com/direct and click the button.

popupNotThread.message: This tab is not an Instagram DM conversation.

keepOpen.message: Keep this tab and the Instagram tab open. The Instagram tab will scroll by itself to the start of the conversation.

stepScan.message: Reading the conversation (scrolling up): $MESSAGES$ messages, $REELS$ Reels

done.message: Done: $SENT$ sent, $RECEIVED$ received, $FAILED$ failed. The download has started.

noReels.message: No Reels were found in this conversation.

notLoggedIn.message: You are not logged in to instagram.com in this browser.

noMessages.message: Could not read any message from this conversation. Make sure it is open in the Instagram tab and try again.

videoNotFound.message: video not found (deleted, private account or Instagram changed its format)
